description:
Checks one package version (npm, PyPI, Go, crates.io, Packagist, RubyGems, Maven, NuGet) against OSV.dev: advisory ids, severity, CVSS, fixed-in versions and malicious flags. Free tier: 30 calls/day per IP with full results, then $0.001 per call in USDC over x402 (/v1/package).

[PkgGuard via YourAITools MCP Hub] Free tier: same as PkgGuard's own MCP server (call without payment and without tier). Paid: package $0.001 per call, with a credits key (Authorization: Bearer yatc_...) or x402 (USDC; the hub returns the payment terms). Failed tool calls aren't charged: credits are refunded automatically and x402 payments only settle on success.
